import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define GSL types and functions
class gsl_matrix_complex(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

class gsl_vector(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

class gsl_eigen_hermv_workspace(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

class gsl_complex(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("dat", ctypes.c_double * 2)]

# Define function prototypes

# Allocation functions
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex)
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector)
gsl.gsl_vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_hermv_workspace)
gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]

# Free functions
gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_hermv_workspace)]
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex)]
gsl.gsl_vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector)]

# Set and get functions
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, gsl_complex]
gsl.gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector), ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_get.restype = gsl_complex
gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]

# Eigen function
gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_vector), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_eigen_hermv_workspace)]
gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv.restype = ctypes.c_int

def compute_eigen(matrix, size):
    if len(matrix) != size or any(len(row) != size for row in matrix):
        raise ValueError("Input must be a square matrix of the given size.")

    # Allocate GSL structures
    A = gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc(size, size)
    eval = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(size)
    evec = gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_alloc(size, size)
    workspace = gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv_alloc(size)

    # Populate the GSL matrix with input data
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(size):
            real, imag = matrix[i][j]
            gsl_complex_value = gsl_complex((ctypes.c_double * 2)(real, imag))
            gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_set(A, i, j, gsl_complex_value)

    # Call the GSL function
    status = gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv(A, eval, evec, workspace)
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("GSL function gsl_eigen_hermv failed")

    # Extract eigenvalues
    eigenvalues = []
    for i in range(size):
        eigenvalues.append(gsl.gsl_vector_get(eval, i))

    # Extract eigenvectors
    eigenvectors = []
    for i in range(size):
        eigenvector = []
        for j in range(size):
            complex_value = gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_get(evec, i, j)
            eigenvector.append((complex_value.dat[0], complex_value.dat[1]))
        eigenvectors.append(eigenvector)

    # Free GSL structures
    gsl.gsl_eigen_hermv_free(workspace)
    gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free(A)
    gsl.gsl_vector_free(eval)
    gsl.gsl_matrix_complex_free(evec)

    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: 2x2 matrix
    matrix = [[(1, 0), (0, 0)], [(0, 0), (2, 0)]]
    size = 2
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = compute_eigen(matrix, size)
    assert np.allclose(eigenvalues, [1, 2]), "Test case 1 failed"

    # Test case 2: 3x3 matrix
    matrix = [[(1, 0), (0, 0), (0, 0)], [(0, 0), (2, 0), (0, 0)], [(0, 0), (0, 0), (3, 0)]]
    size = 3
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = compute_eigen(matrix, size)
    assert np.allclose(eigenvalues, [1, 2, 3]), "Test case 2 failed"

    # Test case 3: Error handling for non-square matrix
    try:
        matrix = [[(1, 0), (0, 0)]]
        size = 2
        compute_eigen(matrix, size)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        assert False, "Test case 3 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
